cases.description: Should trigger: fully-local Agent N message video
cases.input: Produce the 'Agent N presents a message' video for the Herald release.
cases.expect: Runs herald_pipeline_m5.sh with spec and anchor through all six local stages
assertions: Kokoro mature TTS (sid 10), LTX-2.3 MLX A2V render leg
Karaoke captions word-synced to TRUE script
Trims to voice +2.5s, passes QA gate, generates X caption

cases.description: Should trigger: announcement / newsletter video message
cases.input: Make an Agent N announcement video about the new release.
cases.expect: Activates the pipeline with segmented mode for >10s messages
assertions: Splits by sentence boundaries via queue_segments.py
Re-anchors each segment on the identity image
Runs stage-by-stage with env gate checks

cases.description: Should trigger: troubleshooting local pipeline pitfalls
cases.input: The A2V render failed at the end with 'ffmpeg not found on PATH'.
cases.expect: Applies known pitfall fix: symlink ffmpeg/ffprobe into Comfy venv bin or export PATH

cases.description: Not trigger: only writing the X caption, no video
cases.input: Write the X caption that announces the Agent N video.
Use the old cloud Herald pipeline with grok-imagine and volcengine.
cases.expect: Notes the local replacement but does not force local if user explicitly wants cloud
assertions: No M5 pipeline forced without user agreement
